views.label: Hero
views.note: 2026 by weekday, every month its own color: nine slides out, nine back, a hold.

views.label: Detail, 2.5×
views.note: January to February at rest: the letters take the cells before the 1st.

views.label: Detail, 3.5×, sliding
views.note: Halfway through the ninth slide, the furthest the calendar comes apart.

views.label: Two lines a month
views.note: Each month in reading order over two rows, so the second row is the month's length.

views.label: Free shape
views.note: The year in reading order inside a shape drawn from a seeded field.

views.label: Free shape, islands
views.note: The same field as islands: the year poured into blobs.

views.label: Typeface, Mono Fine
views.note: The hero set in PP Right Serif Mono Fine.

views.label: Typeface, Kyoto
views.note: The hero set in PP Kyoto Medium, a proportional serif in the same cells.

views.label: Two colors
views.note: Months alternate between blue and yellow.

views.label: One color
views.note: Every month blue: the shape alone carries the year.
The next year: the 1sts move one weekday on and the holes change.
